paper.title: A Distribution Optimization Framework for Confidence Bounds of Risk Measures

unmapped: Arms are evaluated by CVaR of their loss distribution at level alpha (risk-sensitive objective) rather than the mean; regret measured in CVaR gaps
Loss distributions supported on [a, infinity) with known lower bound a (the bound also involves an upper bound b)
settings.definition_quote: The performance of an algorithm $\pi$ is measured by the cumulative regret \[\text{Regret}(\pi,\nu,N)\triangleq \bE\brk{\sum_{t\in[N]} \rT(F_{I_t})-\min_{i\in[K]}\rT(F_{i}) }.\]

algorithms.name: Lower Confidence Bound meta-algorithm (CVaR-UCB when T = CVaR)

symbols.b_up: upper bound b of the loss support
symbols.q_i: F_i^{-1}(1-alpha-2c_i^*), quantile of arm i's loss distribution

conditions: risk measure is CVaR at level alpha
arm 1 is the unique optimal arm (T(F_1) < T(F_i))

source.label: prop:reg
source.quote: The expected regret of Algorithm \ref{alg:lcb} on a instance $\nu\in \sD([a,\infty])$ with $\rT=C_{\alpha}$ is bounded as \text{Regret}(\text{LCB},\nu,N) \leq \frac{4\log(\sqrt{2}N)}{\alpha^2}\sum_{i>1}^K\frac{\prt{b-F_i^{-1}(1-\alpha-2c^*_i)}^2}{\Delta_i}+3\sum_{i=1}^K\Delta_i, where the sub-optimality gap $\Delta_i\triangleq C_{\alpha}(F_i)-C_{\alpha}(F_1)<b-F_i^{-1}(1-\alpha)$...

results.notes: Regret is defined through CVaR values of the chosen arms (risk analogue of pseudo-regret). Instance stated as D([a,inf]) but the bound involves b, the upper support bound; ambiguity in the paper. N is the horizon T.

cited_results.setting_description: CVaR bandit with losses bounded in [a,b], K arms, horizon N
